summary: Close P4 repository readiness with fail-closed go-live evidence synthesis, hosted GitHub protection verification, independent release-identity and staged-asset verification, live connector qualification, and draft-first publication promotion without weakening existing release-security gates.

impacts.evidence: P4 consumes public tenant-scoped connector APIs and retained release evidence; it introduces no new tenant persistence or cross-tenant access path.
Retained P4 evidence is schema-bounded and rejects secret-shaped fields; bearer/GitHub tokens remain process-only inputs and are never emitted to reports.
P4 adds no TORGNEXA product endpoints; live qualification uses the existing connector account, health-history and sync APIs.
No event schemas, event versions or Kafka topics change in P4.
Connector SDK/provider contracts and generated product SDKs are unchanged.
P4 introduces no database migration; the migration catalog remains at 000074.

P4 verifies applied hosted branch rules, independently re-verifies exact-tag Sigstore/SLSA release identity, binds staged GitHub asset SHA-256 digests, requires secret-free worktrees, and permits contents:write checkout only in the protected draft-staging job with persisted credentials disabled.
Production posture requires recent named platform/security approvers; hosted rules must expose Team review protection; public promotion requires a retained P4 PASS artifact.
p4-go-live.json hashes every subordinate evidence report and binds release version, commit and repository to the staged draft and production posture.
P4 does not alter reconciliation execution; optional live sync qualification remains behind an explicit write-awareness acknowledgement.
Webhook egress contracts are unchanged; P4 network calls are qualification clients to GitHub and the existing TORGNEXA HTTPS API.
P4 requires the full P3 topology/load/failure qualification evidence and binds it into the final go-live decision together with live connector and hosted-release evidence.

Publication is draft-first and remains non-public until independent P4 verification; failure before promotion leaves a removable draft, while P3 backup/restore and upgrade rehearsals remain mandatory ancestors.

P4 adds deterministic Python policy tests, shell/YAML/static checks, exact hosted-rule and staged-asset validators, and retains Go1.26.5/Docker/real-hosted facts as fail-closed external qualification inputs.
